description: Search services by query, optionally scoped to a storefront and category, with pagination.

category.description: Service category name or slug to filter by.

query.description: Free text over service name and description, e.g. 'hair braiding', 'phone repair'.

storefrontSlug.description: Limit results to one store by its slug (from search_storefronts). Omit to search across all verified stores.

name: search_services
